reuse.why: Reuses RSchedule, recurConfigToRSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, but no shared function decides the drop-vs-move weekend rule, so it re-derives it as getUpcomingDates, getNextDate and schedule-template already do.

duplication.why: The daily-drops / otherwise-move weekend decision (skipWeekend && frequency === 'daily', isWeekend skip, else getDateWithSkippedWeekend) is a fourth copy of logic already in getUpcomingDates, shared/schedules getNextDate and budget schedule-template.

placement.why: Handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way, matching the tree's layering, though the weekend rule would belong in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the handler, its type registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Readable and small, but a change to the weekend rule now has to be made in four places, and the 3-day padding is an implicit coupling to how far getDateWithSkippedWeekend can move a date.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getDateWithSkippedWeekend for moving; no existing abstraction covers the full drop/move decision to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts: the drop/move branching from getUpcomingDates is reshaped into a single loop with a `drops` flag instead of being extracted and shared.
